top_signals.title: Tokenized stock trading takes off overseas as Goldman, other U.S. companies object
top_signals.summary: Tokenized stocks are gaining momentum in international markets, even as major U.S. companies are pushing back against efforts to introduce them domestically.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
